notes: Large-source unit עַד־לִמְאֹד → very retained: three morphemes fused into one English word under rule 30, headed on מְאֹד. זְנִים → divers kinds of spices reads the italic of spices as the ASV's completion of the elliptical substantive (rule 31); the competing reading marks of spices as one added unit under rule 33. מִרְקַחַת מַעֲשֶׂה → the perfumers' art follows the ASV's possessive recasting with the the on the possessor (rule 29).
